name: The Bund
address: The Bund, Huangpu District, Shanghai, China
notes: Riverside promenade of grand 1920s architecture. Go at night for the Pudong skyline lit up across the water.

name: Nanjing Road
address: Nanjing Xilu, Jing'an District, Shanghai, China
notes: China's most famous pedestrian shopping street.

name: Yu Garden
address: Yu Yuan Garden, Huangpu District, Shanghai, China
notes: Classical garden plus Old Town bazaar — go for soup dumplings nearby.

name: Hongyadong (Hongya Cave)
address: Cangbai Road, Yuzhong District, Chongqing, China
notes: 11-storey stilt complex glowing gold at night — straight out of an animated film.

name: Liziba Station
notes: The light-rail monorail that runs straight through a residential tower.

name: Ciqikou Ancient Town
notes: Old cobbled streets, teahouses, street snacks.

name: Chengdu Research Base of Giant Panda Breeding
nameLocal: 成都大熊猫繁育研究基地
address: 1375 Panda Avenue, Chenghua District, Chengdu, Sichuan, China
notes: Day trip from Chongqing (~1-1.5h bullet train). Go early to catch the pandas active.

name: Avatar Hallelujah Mountain
nameLocal: 阿凡达哈利路亚山（乾坤柱）
address: Yuanjiajie, Wulingyuan District, Zhangjiajie, Hunan, China
notes: The pillar that 'floats' — the postcard viewpoint of Zhangjiajie National Forest Park. In Yuanjiajie, reached via the Bailong glass elevator.

name: Tianmen Mountain
address: Tianmen Mountain, Yongding District, Zhangjiajie, Hunan, China
notes: World's longest cable car (~7.5km) up to the 999-step 'Heaven's Gate' cave and the cliffside glass skywalk.

name: Furong Ancient Town
address: Furong, Yongshun County, Xiangxi, Hunan, China
notes: 2,000-year-old Tujia stilt town built over a thundering waterfall. 25-min bullet train from Zhangjiajie West. Lit up gold at night. Food options are thin — eat before arriving.

name: Tiananmen Square
address: Tian'anmen Square, Dongcheng District, Beijing, China

name: Forbidden City
address: Forbidden City (Palace Museum), Dongcheng District, Beijing, China
notes: Book tickets ahead. Closed Mondays. Climb Jingshan Park behind it for the rooftop view.

name: Great Wall at Mutianyu
address: Mutianyu Great Wall, Huairou District, Beijing, China
notes: Cable car up, restored ramparts, toboggan down. Less crowded than Badaling.

name: Temple of Heaven
address: Temple of Heaven, Dongcheng District, Beijing, China
notes: The great circular hall and its park.

name: Hongbinlou
address: Baiwanzhuang Street, Xicheng District, Beijing, China
notes: Halal Peking duck, est. 1853. No pork, no alcohol on the menu.
